author: Atari
text:
Hello Whenever,

1) yes we are talking about the same time frame

2) hidden kinks are found in the lower time frame. Therefore, you need
to treat it as a FL in the time frame where you found them.

3) scales - that is a big topic to discuss here. Understand the market
is fractal. The same pattern you see in the M1 can also been seen in
M30, but the M1 pattern is part of the M30 pattern. I maybe confusing
you here, so when I have some free time in the future I will attempt to
show an example of scale.

4) Nice chart. yes price hit the FL above. Will it reverse to the TG
on the bottom? For simplicity sake, let say the black FL (above) you
have drawn is the TG. Now for price to come down to your big red box,
you will need to have PA (an engulf) downward.
